achievements.name: Rookie
achievements.description: Completed the game on Casual difficulty or higher.

achievements.name: Survivor
achievements.description: Completed the game on Survival difficulty or higher.

achievements.name: Against All Odds
achievements.description: Completed the game on Nightmare difficulty or higher.

achievements.name: You Asked For It... Again
achievements.description: Complete the game in Classic Mode.

achievements.name: Welcome to Union
achievements.description: Story achievement - take the plunge back into STEM (arrive in Union).

achievements.name: Taken
achievements.description: Story achievement - see a chilling vision.

achievements.name: Not Running This Time
achievements.description: Fight and kill the Guardian outside Union City Hall (Chapter 5).

achievements.name: The Team Psychologist
achievements.description: Story achievement - find a potential ally in the Marrow.

achievements.name: Premature Finale
achievements.description: Story achievement - shut down a bloody performance (Stefano's theater).

achievements.name: Another Ally
achievements.description: Story achievement - find another ally in Union.

achievements.name: Crossing to the Other Side
achievements.description: Story achievement - provide a Harbinger sweet release (defeat the Harbinger).

achievements.name: Spiritual Awakening
achievements.description: Story achievement - come to terms with your past and present.

achievements.name: Fire Walk With Me
achievements.description: Story achievement - make it inside the enemy's stronghold (Theodore's base).

achievements.name: Overcome the Past
achievements.description: Story achievement - your trauma is no more (overcome the final trauma).

achievements.name: Everything Comes Crumbling Down
achievements.description: Story achievement - reach the very end of the world.

achievements.name: Unfortunate Consequence
achievements.description: Story achievement - do what needed to be done to save your daughter.

achievements.name: Backup Ain't Coming
achievements.description: Completed the "Rogue Signal" side mission.

achievements.name: Sykes Out
achievements.description: Completed the "The Last Step" side mission.

achievements.name: Finally Free
achievements.description: Experienced every traumatic encounter and made peace with your inner demons.

achievements.name: You Got Red in You
achievements.description: Used your first Red Gel.

achievements.name: Stick it in My Veins
achievements.description: Completely upgraded all abilities.

achievements.name: Making Things a Little Easier
achievements.description: Used your first High-Grade Weapon Parts.

achievements.name: Now You're Playing with Power
achievements.description: Upgraded a weapon to Level 3.

achievements.name: A Little Extra Kick to it
achievements.description: Upgraded one of your Warden Crossbow bolts to max level.

achievements.name: They Never Even Stood A Chance
achievements.description: Completely upgraded all weapons.

achievements.name: DIY
achievements.description: Crafted something for the first time.

achievements.name: Handyman
achievements.description: Crafted every type of item at least once.

achievements.name: Echoes Within STEM
achievements.description: Observed all Residual Memories.

achievements.name: Doing Some Detecting
achievements.description: Collected 20 files.

achievements.name: Diligent Reader
achievements.description: Collected all files.

achievements.name: Half the Stash
achievements.description: Opened 16 lockers.

achievements.name: Locksmith
achievements.description: Opened all lockers.

achievements.name: Good to See You Again
achievements.description: Acquired the Warden Crossbow.

achievements.name: Chatting With Kidman
achievements.description: Talked to Kidman about all of the photographic slides.

achievements.name: Powerhouse
achievements.description: Acquired all standard weapons.

achievements.name: All in the Family
achievements.description: Collected all of the Mysterious Objects.

achievements.name: Caffeine Addict
achievements.description: Used every Coffee Maker at least once.

achievements.name: Thinning Them Out
achievements.description: Killed 30 enemies.

achievements.name: Clearing a Path
achievements.description: Killed 60 enemies.

achievements.name: Smoke Assassin
achievements.description: Killed 3 enemies using upgraded Smoke Bolts.

achievements.name: Shock Therapy

achievements.name: Wait For It...

achievements.name: Bootable Offense

achievements.name: Melancholy Memories

achievements.name: I'll Take You Down Myself
